steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect circuit breaker or power cable before servicing electrical parts. Reconnect panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the circuit breaker or power cable before servicing.

steps.title: Line voltage stable 108–132 V?
steps.body: 9C1/9C2 occur on blackout or high/low DC link voltage. Measure outlet under load.
steps.sourceExcerpt: 9C1/9C2 occur on blackout or high/low DC link voltage. Measure outlet under load.

steps.title: Correct supply
steps.body: Verify dedicated 15 A circuit, no shared loads, stable utility power. Retry after power restored.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify dedicated 15 A circuit, no shared loads, stable utility power. Retry after power restored.

steps.title: Control panel powers on normally?
steps.body: If supply good but unit pauses with 9C, inspect CN101/CN802 and main PBA after surge event.
steps.sourceExcerpt: If supply good but unit pauses with 9C, inspect CN101/CN802 and main PBA after surge event.

steps.title: Replace main PBA
steps.body: Replace main PBA when supply verified stable but 9C1/9C2 persists.
steps.oemOutcome: Replace main PBA when supply verified stable but 9C1/9C2 persists.

steps.title: Supply OK
steps.body: Line voltage normal — if fault recurs, log brownout events.
steps.oemOutcome: Line voltage normal — if fault recurs, log brownout events.
